body.purpose: Explanatory copy, selector labels, and controls.

shadows.name: map-control
shadows.purpose: Separates zoom controls from map detail.

shadows.name: map-tooltip
shadows.purpose: Keeps province labels readable over the map.

motion.name: province-fill
motion.purpose: Softens province hover and focus fill changes.

motion.name: loading-spin

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Compact brand link and country context, with a divider below.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:20px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #dce3de; color:#25342f; font:600 14px 'Avenir Next',Avenir,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; color:inherit; text-decoration:none; } .ds-country { color:#61706a; font-weight:400; } .ds-mark { position:relative; display:grid; width:25px; height:25px; place-items:center; border:1px solid #cbd7d0; border-radius:8px; background:#e8efea; } .ds-mark:before,.ds-mark:after,.ds-mark i { position:absolute; display:block; content:''; border:1px solid #16877f; border-radius:50%; } .ds-mark:before { width:15px; height:15px; } .ds-mark:after { width:8px; height:8px; } .ds-mark i { width:2px; height:2px; background:#16877f; }

components.name: Province Selector
components.description: Full-width province row with highlight swatch and focus state.
components.css: .ds-province { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; width:100%; min-height:56px; padding:12px 0; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid #dce3de; background:transparent; color:#25342f; text-align:left; font:500 15px 'Avenir Next',Avenir,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:color 160ms ease; } .ds-province:hover { color:#20332d; } .ds-province:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #16877f; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-province-label { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; } .ds-province-label i { width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:3px; background:#16877f; } .ds-state { color:#89958f; font-size:11px; font-weight:500; }

components.name: Retry Button
components.description: Map load recovery action shown in the error state.
components.css: .ds-retry { display:block; margin:20px auto 0; padding:10px 16px; border:0; border-radius:10px; background:#253d35; color:#fff; font:500 14px 'Avenir Next',Avenir,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 120ms ease; } .ds-retry:active { transform:scale(.98); } .ds-retry:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #16877f; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Map Frame
components.description: Clipped, bordered canvas for province geometry, states, and source credit.
components.css: .ds-map-frame { position:relative; min-height:440px; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid #e1e7e2; border-radius:14px; background:#edf2ee; } .ds-map-placeholder { display:grid; min-height:440px; place-items:center; color:#788780; font:600 18px 'Avenir Next',Avenir,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; } .ds-map-credit { position:absolute; right:10px; bottom:8px; padding:4px 7px; border-radius:5px; background:rgb(248 250 248 / 86%); color:#66766e; font:400 10px/1.25 'Avenir Next',Avenir,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; }

components.name: Province Tooltip
components.description: Sticky province label displayed over the map.
components.css: .ds-tooltip { display:inline-block; padding:6px 9px; border:0; border-radius:7px; background:#253d35; color:#fff; box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgb(37 52 47 / 18%); font:600 12px 'Avenir Next',Avenir,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; }

components.name: Map Zoom Controls
components.description: Light stacked zoom controls with hover emphasis and a quiet shadow.
components.css: .ds-zoom { display:inline-flex; flex-direction:column; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid #d9e1dc; border-radius:9px; background:#fbfcfa; box-shadow:0 3px 14px rgb(37 52 47 / 10%); } .ds-zoom button { width:34px; height:34px; border:0; background:#fbfcfa; color:#32443d; font:500 20px/34px 'Avenir Next',Avenir,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-zoom button+button { border-top:1px solid #e3e9e5; } .ds-zoom button:hover,.ds-zoom button:focus-visible { background:#f0f5f1; color:#16877f; } .ds-zoom button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #16877f; outline-offset:-2px; }

narrative.overview:
The name describes the implemented surface: a national province map paired with a compact consultation panel. The interface is quiet and information-led, using a pale green-gray canvas, restrained borders, and small controls so provincial boundaries remain the focus.

The current map highlights Formosa, Córdoba, and Buenos Aires with separate key colors. The boundary source is credited in the interface. There are no locale markers because location records have not been supplied; future location data should enter as sourced geographic information within this existing map context.
keyCharacteristics: Muted, green-tinted neutrals around a prominent provincial map.
Three distinct colors identify the requested provinces.
Compact labels, thin dividers, and restrained control shadows.
Location content appears only when its source data is available.

rules.name: The Source-True Map Rule
rules.body: Keep the three existing highlight colors tied to their named provinces, and show locale marks only after coordinates and associated data have a known source.

dos: Do keep Formosa, Córdoba, and Buenos Aires mapped to their existing teal, terracotta, and ochre colors.
Do credit geographic boundaries and keep supporting information visually quieter than the map.
Do add future location marks only from supplied coordinate and location records.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior when extending interactive controls.
donts: Don't place illustrative or sample locale markers on the map before location data is supplied.
Don't use the province highlight colors for unrelated meanings without updating the map key.
Don't add a heavy card treatment that competes with the provincial map.
